6064630417662673057.title: Bear
more: Lumbering forth with the weight of old forests and the silence of falling snow, the Brown Bear mount is a beast carved from the memory of the wild itself. Cloaked in thick, shaggy fur that ranges from sun-dappled ochre to the deep umber of rich soil, it bears the form of a great tusked boar twisted by ancient magic and bound to the shape of the bear. Its curved tusks gleam with the wear of many battles, and the heavy hump upon its back speaks of strength stored like thunder behind the clouds. Though massive in form, it moves with surprising agility, scaling trees and ledges with ease, guided by a nose that can scent danger across valleys and ears that catch whispers in the wind. Found in many lands and climates, it is a companion of the bold and the enduring, a mount that does not dazzle but endures, and in that endurance finds dominion over all terrain.

6064631120728621058.title: Daystrider
more: Towering and odd-looking, the Daystrider Mule is a beast unlike any other. First discovered by a Kaelar mining crew in the mountains, this strange quadruped?s spindly legs and elongated face left quite an impression. Its peculiar snout allows it to root out insects from high cliff walls, and it remains remarkably stable even on treacherous terrain. Horses often falter in Verra?s more rugged regions, but the Daystrider glides over them with ease. Despite its intimidating height, the creature proved gentle and easy to train. Once coaxed with handfuls of insects, it was even rideable. It can carry large loads, traverse unstable ground, and move surprisingly fast when motivated by food. This bizarre yet capable mount has since become a beloved companion to adventurers willing to look past its unusual silhouette.

6064631121002364944.title: Wyrmling
6064631121002364944.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064631714156380160.description: Required to enchant gear, reduces gold cost of enchanting by 100%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631720005468277.title: Worn Binder
6064631720005468277.description: The binder is worn and ripped. It is titled, 'The Last Acount of Alred K. Krudd the Chronicler.'

sources.name: [There are broken spyglasses of various sizes and charts of the hill covered in blood and torn. Among the debris you also find a minotaur coin. Amongst the clutter you see a log book.]

6064631726068662298.title: Ripped Page 4
6064631726068662298.description: This page was ripped out of a binder. It is Kaelar script and sounds like the ramblings of one persons Last Account.

6064631799251664906.title: Translated Goblin Scroll
6064631799251664906.description: This scroll was translated by Scribe Monroe at the Scholars Academy camp. It reads, 'Gravehide strong and always ready. The Master promises big rewards soon. I need to meet the eye people at the old camp, north of Carphin, by the crumbled bridge. Stay hidden and wait for the sign.'

sources.name: This isn't too complex, even though I'm out of practice. It translates to, 'Gravehide strong and always ready. The Master promises big rewards soon. I need to meet the eye people at the old camp, north of Carphin, by the crumbled bridge. Stay hidden and wait for the sign.' It ends lacking any signature, likely to obscure the author. It doesn't take a Lord Archon of the academy to see that this is a message to the goblins of the Gravehide tribe.

6064631827368050693.description: Porceilion believed fear is a form of honesty. The cap named for him disagrees. It thinks fear is hilarious, and delights in exploiting the deepest anxieties of mortal men.

6064631827425722375.title: Bloodmother's Sanguine Pearls

sources.name: Although you are not the first, I believe you will succeed where others have failed. I sense it. Go and confirm these locations and may Kyronu keep you from corruption. [He holds out a scroll]

6064632282343015451.title: Windswept Claw
6064632282343015451.description: Claw of a raven, watch out it's sharp.

more:
Bag Size: Small

Must be empty to unequip
A great bag to begin your journey!

6064632282858127392.title: Desecrated Ring
6064632282858127392.description: A ring tarnished from lands far away. Amber ring encased in iron. The cracked iron shows the amber within.

6064632282874576938.title: Doomsday Necklace
6064632282874576938.description: Imbued with blood crystals which invoke a dark energy. Harsh spikes surround this necklace giving it a chilling look. Put it on carefully.

6064632282878640172.title: Gem of Shotcaller
6064632282878640172.description:
Drop: The Shotcaller 
Ingredient In: Jeweler
more: The golden gem of the bandit captain Shotcaller.

6064632383594889292.title: Weathered Scroll
6064632383594889292.description: A weathered scroll inscribed with information on dealings between the bandits and a group of cultists.

6064632394955292675.title: King Jarrak's Unity: Vol I
6064632394955292675.description: A quote by King Jarrak etched on a small metal plate. "Strength in unity, honor in battle".

6064632500964687876.title: Oath of the Kyronic Order
6064632500964687876.description: From the celestial wellspring, the tendrils of vitality and purification shall reach out to us. From coil to soul to hand, I give myself to then life flow. Born of Vyra and nurtured by Kyron, the essence of pure life shall preserve all that is good, through my hands to all.

6064632575185911811.title: Spare Wagon Wheel
6064632575185911811.description: This appears to be a refurbished wagon wheel.

6064632577005322262.title: Timeless Tiller's Bone Fragments
6064632577005322262.description:
Drop: Timeless Tiller 
Ingredient In: Jeweler
more: Timeless Tiller remains timeless through the bones of his skeleton.

6064632577046806556.title: Gatekeeper's Earring
6064632577046806556.description: Petite key-shaped earrings, carven of bone, and capped with silver skulls.

6064632577052442656.title: Recipe: Everlasting Sower's Bone Necklace
6064632577052442656.description: Apprentice Jeweler recipe for Everlasting Sower's Bone Necklace.

6064632700250362727.title: Rite of Purification
6064632700250362727.description: A weathered scroll with frayed edges, etched with crimson and gold runes. Symbols of earth, sky, and ancestors intertwine. It smells of sage and ash, radiating a quiet, solemn energy.

sources.name: I need to gather the items requested by T'kano the Sightless to made the Elixir of Spirits.

6064632706491547653.title: Pamphlet: 'Our Family Fights!'
6064632706491547653.description: A loose page of thin paper bearing large block-printed titles - torn from a wall or post.

6064632711139229847.title: Useless Junk
6064632711139229847.description: A clump of rotted wood, broken clay shards, and unidentifiable goop and grime. It's clear from inspection that it's not worth keeping.

6064632715899699207.title: Glittering Metal Strand
6064632715899699207.description:
Drop: Befallen Forge 
Ingredient In: Jeweler, Armorsmithing, Leatherworking, Tailoring, Metalworking, Weaponsmithing, Arcane Engineering, Carpentry
more: A short length of metal wire infused with the essence of those who opposed the Toren Empire's mad reign. The accursed process that led to this creation has been lost to time.

6064632734631264806.description: Idleness under Toren rule was punishable by lashings. Administrators found it useful to wear padded armor around the workers in the event that they resisted consequences.

6064632739878076441.description: Old Dunzen forging techniques were the greatest in recorded history. To recover even a mundane piece made during the height of their forgecraft is a windfall for any adventurer.

6064632746559209509.title: Forgescale
6064632746559209509.description: A crude and unwieldy shield, forged from layers of thick, overlapping forge scale and slag. The iron, poorly worked and riddled with impurities, forms a protective mass that is more about sheer weight and density than refined craftsmanship.

6064632750948745226.title: Harrowed Stars Necklace
6064632750948745226.description: Proximity to the ancient capital meant that The Church of the Seven Stars had the space and wealth to construct elaborate shrines to each of the seven gods. Even lesser clerics and temple staff wore symbols of their faith in semi-precious metals and gems.

6064632756771291205.title: Recipe: Forgelord's Signet
6064632756771291205.description: Journeyman Jeweler recipe for Forgelord's Signet.

6064632758002845102.title: Cloak of Aithanahr
6064632758002845102.description: Cloak granted to Aithanahr citizens. Prosperity to Aithanahr!

6064632778825400325.title: Aithanahr Siege Contract
6064632778825400325.description:
Purchase: Aithanahr Barracks 
Ingredient In: Tailoring

6064632780450365443.title: Embroidered Siege Banner
more: A masterfully crafted banner, embroidered with intricate symbols of war and conquest. This essential item, created by skilled tailors, is a declaration of intent to lay siege to a settlement.

6064632780953812992.title: Spindlevine Rooting Ball
6064632780953812992.description: This self-fertilizing root ball that will grow spindlevine when planted in a freehold.

6064632784208265220.title: Grave Lily Seed
more: Grave lily seed can be used to grow more grave lily.

6064632937120989187.title: Sandsquall Croc
6064632937120989187.description:
Gather: Sandsquall Desert 
Ingredient In: Animal Husbandry

6064632937160245255.title: Dynasty Beetle Beast Of Burden
6064632937160245255.description: A fine beast trained to pull caravans.

6064632937175711754.title: Bonestrider Beast Of Burden
6064632937175711754.description: A fine beast trained to pull caravans.

6064632954941538306.title: Poppy
6064632954941538306.description:
Gather: Sandsquall Desert 
Ingredient In: Alchemy

6064632983373348864.title: Beetleplate Helm
6064632983373348864.description: The chitinous cap of a giant cave scarab makes up the body of this sturdy helm. The eyes and face of the creature have been preserved and fashioned into an intimidating visage.

6064632983376625689.title: Bitterquill
6064632983376625689.description: This flashing blade was forged from the iron-hard tip of the Sandsquall Giant Scorpion's lethal stinger, the injuries caused by which rarely even necessitate poison. It is surprisingly light, and fast as a scorpion's tail.

6064632983531159585.title: Sabatons of Gault
6064632983531159585.description: The ritual of Preservation requires that the Chosen's feet be bound in sandy clay, then daubed with arcane bindings that become empowered by channeled essence. The rigid pottery becomes leather-soft when worn by a living creature.

6064632983872536704.title: Djinn's Essence
6064632983872536704.description:
Drop: Farajah's Laborer 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: A swirling wisp of ethereal energy trapped in a crystalline vial. It shimmers with an ever-changing spectrum of colors, whispering of forbidden wishes.

6064632983997579399.title: Recipe: Hollowhued Breastplate
6064632983997579399.description: Journeyman Armorsmithing recipe for creating Hollowhued Breastplate.

6064632994598879268.title: Obsidian Powder
6064632994598879268.description:
Process: Alchemy 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering

6064633011240304642.title: Recipe: Dustbound Earring
6064633011240304642.description: Apprentice Jeweler recipe for: Dustbound Earring

6064633011572178944.title: Stolen Ingot
6064633011572178944.description: This stolen ingot still bears the stamp of the Greyshore Transporters and has not been recast by raiders to hide the fact that it was taken from a caravan.

6064633017398329425.title: Rubbing Parchment
6064633017398329425.description: A thin parchment that is used to transfer the script and images of stone etching via the rubbing technique.

sources.name: The pillars were ancient signs of some sort. They hold the same message written in a few languages. If we get rubbings of all, I can create a cypher.

6064633017421791314.title: Rubbing of the Pillars of Al'Ashal
6064633017421791314.description: This rubbing transfered the ancient script of Meridjinn that was inscribed upon the lost Pillars of Al'Ashal.

sources.name: Discover the ancient Pillars of Al'Ashal near the remnants of Miradina.

6064633067428315148.title: Recipe: Cataphract Of Valor Stechhelm
6064633067428315148.description: Journeyman Armorsmithing recipe for creating Cataphract Of Valor Stechhelm.

6064633067508727836.title: Recipe: Vestments Of War Legs
6064633067508727836.description: Journeyman Tailoring recipe for Vestments Of War Legs.

6064633073781112879.title: Ostracon
6064633073781112879.description: A shard of stoneware inscribed with ancient lettering.

6064633135436988416.title: Scarhide Mantle
6064633135436988416.description: Sandsquall crocodiles are slow-thinking creatures of habit, territorial and fiercely protective of their ponds. Their hides, scarred from infighting, are nevertheless ideal for lightweight armor that turns blades as readily as it turned clutchmates' teeth.

6064633210442547980.title: XirvethisToxin
6064633210442547980.description: The substance in the vial looks innocuous but you know it to be deadly.

6064633221016387589.title: Plumeria Wood
6064633221016387589.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea 
Ingredient In: Lumber Milling

6064633255330447363.title: Caravel
6064633255330447363.description: Use: Deploy your Caravel within range of the Harbor. After 10 seconds your Caravel will be summoned.
more: A useful piece of technology, used to magically summon a Caravel from a distance.

6064633267296010246.title: Glintbound Bezoar
6064633267296010246.description: While some Glintbound Bezoars can be quite plain, others boast an otherworldly luster and an irregular shape, resembling a river-worn stone. They are surprisingly warm to the touch and radiate subtle magical energy. While the majority of these stones appear plain grey or beige at first, subtle ribbons of color on their surface shift between deep blues, purples, and iridescent highlights. Flecks of Glint can sometimes give the impression that tiny stars are trapped deep within.

6064633271737188428.title: Sunfire Twin Daggers
6064633271737188428.description: Straight grinds and stout tangs, reliable as a bridge set firm over spring flood.

6064633288742993927.title: Tattered Silken Sock
6064633288742993927.description:
Drop: Nearly Dead Prisoner 
Ingredient In: Tailoring
more: Threadbare silk, frayed and stained, clings to worn fabric. Patches are stitched haphazardly, barely holding together. The once-lustrous sheen is gone, replaced by a dull, aged pallor, and a decidedly musty smell.

6064633289003040784.title: Everlight Shard
6064633289003040784.description:
Drop: Deadman's Armor 
Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: The invited guests who wandered the halls were surprised to see them guarded by floating sentries made of enchanted ore. While dazzling in appearance, guests were warned that these attendants could quickly turn violent if provoked.

6064633289003106321.title: Elemental Heart of Light
more: Olek Bellsong, working steadfastly in his tower, hammered the unruly elemental core, splitting it in two! This half, a core of pure luminescence, flashes with brilliant cold light.

6064633289557999665.title: Dustpaw Warhide
6064633289557999665.description: Armor once strapped to a warbear. The fine craftsmanship makes it superior in many ways. Something of such quality will not go to waste and can be conformed to fit any of the exalted races.

6064633289615868068.title: Branch of the Kesatal
6064633289615868068.description: He selected bits of bones from the deep ocean and fused them together upon the head of this staff like wings made of too many fingers. Kesatal always employed a loose definition of what constitutes 'wings.'

6064633293524697193.title: Recipe: Glorybound Dancing Blades
6064633293524697193.description: Journeyman Weaponsmithing recipe for: Glorybound Dancing Blades

6064633367262396416.title: 2nd Sword Division's Helm
6064633367262396416.description: Helmet worn by the 2nd Sword Division, the first Kaelar expeditionary unit to step through the Divine Portal to arrive at Lionhold.

6064633374112874527.title: Powder Barrel
6064633374112874527.description: The distinctive mark of the Seaspirited is scorched into the side, a symbol of their once-proud ownership. The faint scent of alchemy clings to the barrel, hinting at the volatile contents hidden within.

sources.name: Upon closer inspection, you notice a faint, almost imperceptible trace of powder seeping from small cracks in the wood--likely a bit of alchemy powder or some other volatile material.

6064633425481695236.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Wildport
6064633425481695236.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Wildport.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Wildport to place this banner.

6064633447849001148.title: Brinebeard Boots
6064633447849001148.description: Within the ranks of the Jundark Raiders is the pirate first mate, Brinebeard. A pirate whose name was lost to his defiance of high seas execution. No less than 10 times was this infamous pirate forced to walk the plank and each time he returned to raid again.

6064633452949078016.title: Razorback Sucker
6064633452949078016.description: Can be plucked from the water by a Master Fisher.

6064633452968214533.title: Brightflit
6064633452968214533.description: Can be plucked from the water by a Master Fisher.

6064633454045102548.title: Recipe: Iron Wing Shroud
6064633454045102548.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Iron Wing Shroud.

6064633464871714833.title: Crate of Korrinian Flowers
6064633464871714833.description:
This heavily-perfumed crate is packed with a variety of flower samples gathered from the hills surrounding Korrin.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Crate of Seahook Figurines

Figurines of soldiers carved from stone found around Seahook.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Seahook Cutware

A crate of golden cutware forged in Shorefoot.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Coral Ornaments

A crate of small ornaments carved from coral in the Brinebarrel region.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Elephant Meat
Requires Journeyman Cooking to prepare.

6064633465752911913.title: Voided Siege Declaration Banner - Brinebarrel
6064633465752911913.description: Voided siege declaration due to price issues.

6064633493403074567.title: Harness
6064633493403074567.description: A harness for your caravan beast of burden

6064633696439697415.title: Windansea Siege Contract
6064633696439697415.description:
Purchase: Windansea Barracks 
Ingredient In: Tailoring

6064633747176710742.title: Obsidian Prism
6064633747176710742.description: The glassy remains of a shattered elemental. Unlike other ore deposits, this Prism is cut directly from the obsidian ores within the Pit of Golgora. It's raw form shifts beneath the surface in response to the beholder's mortal essence.  It appears almost judgmental... realigning its facets according to the imprint of this soul as if to measure its worthiness.

6064633776266150000.title: Warhorn of Umbraxis
6064633776266150000.description: A ceremonial horn used in times of war. It calls upon the legions to bring resolve and unity to the battlefield.

6064633780776075265.title: Heartstone Locket
6064633780776075265.description: A darksteel pendant encases the pulsing Heartstone, its glow shifting with elemental force. Varnok's runes bind fire, water, and earth in tension.

sources.name: Among his abandoned creations rests a pendant of darksteel, polished to oily sheen and set apart with deliberate precision. A hairline seam runs along its edge, barely containing something glowing from within.

6064633783596613850.title: Twisted Whip
6064633783596613850.description: A braided cord of dark, glistening hair from an unknown animal, knotted with rusted barbs. Its heft incites a desire to flay the hide from something living, preferably something mewling.

6064633803432329339.title: Drain Key
6064633803432329339.description: A large bronze key. It is unlike any other key you know of. Grooves at the end hint that it might be used to turn something. Common Dunzenkell runes letters indicate "Regulator"

6064633860908646438.title: Hallowmark Treads
6064633860908646438.description: Never scuffed, though the ground beneath seems to dim in response.

6064633860909367343.title: Suncleft Choir Boots
6064633860909367343.description: When worn upon the stone, these boots do not echo. Travelers say the silence is not natural, but granted, an old courtesy kept from the time when voices alone could shape the will of the mountain.

6064633860910743619.title: Scorchwander Bracers
6064633860910743619.description: Etched with sun-faded patterns drawn from mirage-bound maps, these bracers tighten when heat rises. Movements grow sure when silence weighs heavy.

6064633860915921045.title: Cindermarch Pauldrons
6064633860915921045.description: Rise in a curve like the rim of a forge shield, their weight balanced to protect without slowing the arms.

6064633860916248729.title: Brinetread Cape
6064633860916248729.description: Swings with the slow rhythm of the tide, its edges stiffened by salt and wind, carrying the scent of open water.

6064633860916248736.title: Brinetread Belt
6064633860916248736.description: Secures the set with a firm, balanced knot, its pouches and loops ready for tools or weaponry at need.

6064633860916773027.title: Gritmantle Jerkin
6064633860916773027.description: Balanced between freedom and defense, its layered form built to endure both the heat of the day and the clash of close combat.

6064633860917166256.title: Veilrender Spaulders
6064633860917166256.description: Angled like the wings of a hunting bird, they turn the fall of leaf and branch aside before it can snag or slow.

6064633860917887159.title: Ferncloak Leggings
6064633860917887159.description: Move with the stride, unbinding at the knee and hip so a leap across stream or ditch comes without pause.

6064633860919066834.title: Dunecoil Leggings
6064633860919066834.description: Cut for long hours in the saddle or on foot, they flex with each movement without binding at the hip or knee.

6064633860919525594.title: Gloomraider Boots
6064633860919525594.description: Step sure over roots and mud-slick stone, each footfall chosen to keep pace without sound.

6064633860920901879.title: Tidepiercer Bracers
6064633860920901879.description: Bound close to the forearm with salt-hardened straps, the metal chased with wave-crest patterns worn soft by touch.

6064633860921491719.title: Duskhunter Boots
6064633860921491719.description: Step with quiet assurance over damp earth and knotted roots, their tread steady even on the slick stone of forgotten paths.

6064633860947050788.title: Deepward Bastion Gauntlets
6064633860947050788.description: Their grip knows the heft of broken pick and silent hammer. Iron sings soft where knuckles meet steel, like the last breath of a forge gone cold.

6064633860947509546.title: Glenwarden Cuirass
6064633860947509546.description: This chestpiece is layered in plates shaped like fallen leaves, each etched with warding marks older than the roads they guarded. Moss once grew between the seams, and some claim it still tries.

6064633860947509552.title: Glenwarden Pauldrons
6064633860947509552.description: Wide but quiet, these shoulders were built to bear thorns and storm both. Each ridge echoes the curve of Riverland ridgelines seen at dusk.

6064633860948164918.title: Undermarch Gauntlets
6064633860948164918.description: Their fingers are jointed like the keys of a vault. Once used to lift stones from tomb thresholds, they now close with a sound like gravel shifting in a dry basin.

6064633860948820286.title: Verdant Yoke Vambraces
6064633860948820286.description: Braced in bramble-hardened loops, these forearm guards bear the strength of thickets undisturbed for centuries. Their touch carries the bite of patient growth.

6064633860949147973.title: Crownbreaker Breastplate
6064633860949147973.description: Cast in the mold of buried champions, this armor rings with the silence of old battlefields. Its surface holds the memory of rites carved into riverstone and the echo of oaths shouted beneath a storm-wet sky.

6064633860983357854.title: Moltruin Cape
6064633860983357854.description: Trails in dark folds like smoke rising from a forge vent, carrying the heat-haze shimmer of fires that have burned since the first stone split.

6064633860983685548.title: Brineplate Helm
6064633860983685548.description: Shields the mind in the quiet vigilance of the deep, where no storm can touch and only the watchful whispers of the drowned remain.

6064633860984275386.title: Graveplate Breastplate
6064633860984275386.description: Shields the body as the earth shields its dead, each plate a silent vow to endure against the unseen things that stalk beneath the jungle's darkened leaves.

6064633860986044885.title: Scaldplate Breastplate
6064633860986044885.description: Holds the chest as a kiln holds its fire, the plates forged to bear both the weight of battle and the unrelenting blaze above.

6064633860986044891.title: Scaldplate Pauldrons
6064633860986044891.description: Rise from the shoulders like sunlit battlements, deflecting the strike while standing tall against the desert wind.

6064633860986372581.title: Cryptward Faulds
6064633860986372581.description: Layered to protect the body's center as the inner walls protect the heart of the tomb, each plate a barrier against intrusion.

6064633860987224551.title: Stoneglen Cuirass
6064633860987224551.description: Holds the chest in the sure frame of cut stone, each plate shaped to endure the press of battle as the glens endure the turn of the seasons.

6064633860999086642.title: Ashwoke Vestment
6064633860999086642.description: This layered chestpiece bears the scent of smoldered resin and ash-slick stone. It fits as if shaped in a moment between ruin and rebirth.

6064633861004132928.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Hood
6064633861004132928.description: Woven in twilight beneath ancestral arches, this hood veils the bearer in a hush older than words. Its lining hums faintly with the residue of seven blessings, said to guide the will when silence must become judgment.

6064633861004657226.title: Unfallen Rainment Leggings
6064633861004657226.description: Dyed in the shifting hues of coastal dusk, these leggings move with the ease of reef currents. Their weave mirrors the paths of seabirds over open water, charting a course between memory and tide.

6064633861005247064.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Bracers
6064633861005247064.description: These bracers bear the faint shimmer of protective rites once spoken in the shadowed courts of Miradina. They cradle the forearms like old promises, each band a remnant of resolve honed beneath drifting stars.

6064633861010752180.title: Shadeweft Cape
6064633861010752180.description: Hangs in dark, uneven folds that dissolve into the jungle's dim light, its edges shifting like shadow cast by swaying branches.

6064633861012062906.title: Thistledown Boots
6064633861012062906.description: Step quietly across soft earth and through brush, their tread leaving only the faintest impression before it fades.\

6064633861012259518.title: Glimmersoot Hood
6064633861012259518.description: Shadows the eyes while leaving the face free to breathe in the heat, its edges flickering with ember-bright stitching.

6064633861012259526.title: Glimmersoot Cape
6064633861012259526.description: Shifts like smoke rising from a chimney vent, catching glints of emberlight as it moves in the drafts between stone walls.

6064633861012521673.title: Mistglean Shoulders
6064633861012521673.description: Lie close against the frame, their contour turning aside both the stray strike and the spray of breaking surf.

6064633861012718294.title: Veilsand Bracers
6064633861012718294.description: Rest close at the forearms, turning aside a strike without breaking the flow of the arms in motion.

6064633861012718296.title: Veilsand Cape
6064633861012718296.description: Falls in layered folds the color of sunlit dunes, each shift of fabric blurring the outline of the wearer against the horizon.

6064633861012980442.title: Wraithskin Leggings
6064633861012980442.description: Flow easily with each motion, whether crossing tangled roots or sliding through narrow openings in the canopy.

6064633861014553347.title: Duneflare Bracers
6064633861014553347.description: Rest firm at the forearms, shielding without weight, their shape tuned for both a swift draw and a guarded parry.

6064633866775167002.title: Cindertouched Ring
6064633866775167002.description: Dull to the eye but hot to the palm, this ring was found in a collapsed smelter beneath the Ashen Halls. Its char remains never cool completely, and flickers when misfortune nears.

6064633866776543262.title: Forgebound Earring
6064633866776543262.description: Forged beneath prayer and pressure in the stone-vaulted sanctum of Maultruin, this earring hums faintly with the breath of ancient bellows. Its bearer often dreams of anvils falling like stars.

6064633866776674336.title: Forgebound Ring
6064633866776674336.description: Hammered flat from the trimmings of a sealed vault door, this ring still warms when held near old stone. Those who wear it report a clarity in impact, as though motion seeks its mark.

6064633866786177092.title: Hollowbound Ring
6064633866786177092.description: A narrow band dark as sealed stone, engraved with inward turning lines that seem to fold upon themselves, as if keeping a vigil no voice may break.

6064633866956832854.title: Ashbrand Axe
6064633866956832854.description: Char-marked and soot-hushed, this axe carries the breath of long-cooled forges. Its edge stirs when oathbound hands grip tight.

6064633867061756003.title: Seabright Axe
6064633867061756003.description: Salt-clean shine rides the bevels, the weight trimmed for swift work on spray-wet stone and heaving decks.

6064633867062739046.title: Glorybound Axe
6064633867062739046.description: Polished to a river-stone luster, its lines carry the ceremony of oaths spoken at dawn along old walls.

6064633867063132264.title: Wavecutter Axe
6064633867063132264.description: A keel line runs the belly of the blade, tuned for crisp entry and clean release through knot and rope.

6064633867082006647.title: Verdant Oath Great Axe
6064633867082006647.description: Formed where root meets stone and hafted in living wood, the Verdant Oath Great Axe is warm to the touch even in frost. Flowers left near it wilt quickly, as if the blade draws life before it ever swings.

6064633867088822406.title: Flameheart Great Axe

6064633867113791653.title: Shadowfang Great Grimoire
6064633867113791653.description: Letters lie thin and low, best read when the lamp is hooded and the leaves barely reflect.

6064633867115102375.title: Wavecutter Great Grimoire
6064633867115102375.description: Keel straight rules and clear headings grant a sailor's economy, nothing wasted, nothing loose.

6064633867116150954.title: Deepweld Great Grimoire
6064633867116150954.description: Boards hold a slow forge warmth, and the script carries the steady cadence of hammers counted across long winters.

6064633867119624368.title: Stoneforge Dagger
6064633867119624368.description: The Stoneforge Dagger holds a steady balance, unaffected by weight or wear. It never clinks when set down and seems to dull noise as well as light.

6064633867121000627.title: Sandcarved Dagger
6064633867121000627.description: Its surface wears the mark of long travel and longer exile. It never warms in the hand.

6064633867174674637.title: Sandcarved Focus
6064633867174674637.description: Worn smooth by sun and silence, this focus bears the scoured wisdom of shifting dunes and buried things that do not rest.

6064633867177361621.title: Seabright Focus
6064633867177361621.description: Polished to a sheen, its edges catch the color of shallow water.

6064633867177623766.title: Sunscorch Focus
6064633867177623766.description: Pale gold tones flicker faintly across its smooth face in open light.

6064633867178344664.title: Pyrebrand Focus
6064633867178344664.description: Deep red streaks trace through its core, recalling the breath of the forge.

6064633867186274541.title: Seabright Longbow
6064633867186274541.description: Smooth and salt-polished, it gleams like a cresting wave beneath sunlight.

6064633867187978483.title: Nightreaver Longbow
6064633867187978483.description: Shadows gather along its limbs, swallowing the gleam of passing light.

6064633867198791931.title: Runeweld Mace
6064633867198791931.description: Each impact from the Runeweld Mace leaves behind a faint ring, like a bell that only stone can hear. Its head bears faint symbols that never quite stay the same.

6064633867212685592.title: Coralblade Great Mace
6064633867212685592.description: Heavy as a breaker's heart and slow as the churn beneath the tide, this mace drips with the hush of the deep. It strikes not with sound, but with the silence that follows a storm.

6064633867217666347.title: Mirageborn Great Mace
6064633867217666347.description: Profile seems to blur at the edges, then returns to a true, centered strike.

6064633867218321709.title: Thornstride Great Mace
6064633867218321709.description: A spare briar motif rings the collar, old roads implied in every mark.

6064633867290804724.title: Stoneforge Wand
6064633867290804724.description: Carved from solid core and banded in iron, the Stoneforge Wand holds steady no matter the spell. It resonates faintly when pointed north and grows heavier when idle too long.

6064633895582826496.title: Mount Cosmetic: White Runic Steed
6064633895582826496.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Clad in luminous sigils and a snowy coat, the White Runic Steed carries an aura of ancient magic. Often used by scholars, priests, and battlemages alike, it moves with quiet reverence, as if answering a higher calling. Each hoofstep leaves behind a faint shimmer, marking the path of sacred purpose.

6064633895622475792.title: Mount Cosmetic: Shell of the Ancients
6064633895622475792.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Bearing a carapace heavy with moss and time, the Shell of the Ancients lumbers forward like a living monument. Thought by some to be awakened relics of the First Age, these towering creatures are used as slow but unyielding mounts by sages, guardians, and those who carry the burdens of history on their backs.

6064633895675035688.title: Mount Cosmetic: Ochre Legion Wyrmling
6064633895675035688.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Clad in bronze-hued scales that glint like a sunrise over bloodied fields, the Ochre Legion Wyrmling is as proud as it is temperamental. Though young, it bears the bearing of a beast bred for war, with a serpentine hiss and wings that flicker with latent flame. Once raised by the disciplined hands of imperial drakekeepers, these wyrmlings now serve those bold enough to earn their loyalty through grit alone.

6064633895681589291.title: Cosmetic: Seer of the Infinite
6064633895681589291.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895693451314.title: Mount Cosmetic: Bearded Balemane
6064633895693451314.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Towering and thick with muscle, the Bearded Balemane is a creature of burden and battle, known across Vek lands as both tool and terror. Its coarse mane and downward tusks give it a fearsome presence, while ritual paints mark its role, be it war, work, or travel. Fiercely independent in the wild, it submits only to those who prove themselves through patience and strength. Once bonded, it becomes a steadfast mount, trampling enemies with brutal force and defending its rider without hesitation. Few outside the Vek dare to tame one, and fewer still succeed.

6064633895693778995.title: Cosmetic: Troll of Joyous Artillery
6064633895693778995.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895706558522.title: Mount Cosmetic: Thundering Bolt Beast
6064633895706558522.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Crackling with volatile energy and rumbling with each stride, the Thundering Bolt Beast is a creature of living lightning. Its hide pulses with raw power, and the air around it thrums like a storm about to break. As a mount, it charges into battle with the fury of the heavens themselves.

6064633895723073605.title: Mount Cosmetic: Shatterclaw
6064633895723073605.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Ridden by warriors who thrive in chaos, the Shatterclaw is a brutal beast with jagged armor and gouged talons. It charges into battle with reckless momentum, each strike shaking the ground like a drumbeat of war. Riders claim it thrives on conflict, growing fiercer with every blow it endures.

6064633895740964944.title: Cosmetic: Crystalline Revenant
6064633895740964944.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895776682079.title: Mount Cosmetic: Crested Sunplume
6064633895776682079.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: The Crested Sunplume is an unusually large species of duck, big enough to be ridden and prized as a rare mount. Its vivid, prismatic feathers create a blur of color as it dashes across land or glides through water. Though elegant in appearance, the Sunplume is sturdy and swift, making it a favorite among collectors and traders alike. Rumors persist that its radiant plumage holds strange and mystical properties.

6064633895823540349.title: Cosmetic: Waxwool Ewe
6064633895823540349.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895828979841.title: Mount Cosmetic: Baghorn
6064633895828979841.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Thick-furred and glacier-born, the Baghorn is the Northland merchant?s most trusted companion. Bred to weather blizzards and traverse icy slopes without falter, this stocky beast hauls its burden through the harshest mountain passes without hesitation. Its long, sweeping tail stirs the snow behind it, erasing tracks and offering natural cover for those who value discretion. Wild herds still roam the tundra, but the domesticated Baghorn serves tirelessly, carrying wares, secrets, and survival itself across the frozen frontier. Reliable, rugged, and utterly unmoved by storm or steep, it is the cold season's quiet hero.

6064633895834943620.title: Cosmetic: Deepwood Vyla
6064633895834943620.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895835074693.title: Mount Cosmetic: Stringbok
6064633895835074693.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: With legs like coiled springs and a back built for speed, the Stringbok is a bounding marvel that carries its rider across the land in great, leaping arcs. Known for its agility and wild temperament, it is a mount favored by messengers, scouts, and thrill-seekers who find joy in the chase.

6064633895847854220.title: Cosmetic: Moapua'a
6064633895847854220.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895847985293.title: Mount Cosmetic: Shoalskipper
6064633895847985293.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your aquatic mount.
more: Skimming just above the water?s surface, the Shoalskipper is a swift aquatic mount favored by coastal riders and river-bound couriers. Its iridescent hide glints in the sun as it glides with uncanny speed, weaving between waves like a skipping stone.

6064634002224185347.description: Munch the Accidental Mage was always a prankster. He once gifted his fellow members of the Hidden Hall Magical Society an amulet of charisma that in truth, smelt intensely horrible to the wearer. Most of these were tossed into the drain!

6064634002396151849.title: Golden Strand

6064634002396282922.title: Smeltgum
6064634002396282922.description: A viscous, tarry byproduct oozed from corrupted automata and essence-melting crucibles. Smeltgum seethes with volatile magic, prized for crafting explosive alchemy and incendiary glyphs, but prone to violent combustion if mishandled.
